AboutDescription: A local application for recording PowerShell 7 sessions.
AboutLimitations: This version records PowerShell 7 sessions on Ubuntu through GNOME Terminal. Windows PowerShell 5.1, elevation, macOS, and other terminal emulators are not supported. The History page does not list transcript files yet.
UpdatesAutomaticHelp: When this is on, the application contacts GitHub at most once every 24 hours to read the latest stable release. It does not send customer TAGs, session names, transcripts, or settings.
